# Disk Rescue (diskrescue)
An Unraid plugin for rescuing data from a failing disk. It copies files from a degraded drive to a healthy one, monitors the **average speed over a sliding window** (default 10 seconds / 10 MB/s) and skips a file when it stalls, while keeping whatever was already read as `*.partial` so it can be resumed later.
## Features
- Windowed average-speed detection (configurable window, threshold, sampling) - Configurable grace: multiplier × (file size / threshold), cap, and small-file grace - Keeps partially rescued data as `*.partial` instead of deleting it - Failed/skipped files are written to `disk-rescue-failed.txt` on the target - Dry-run pre-scan (read-only) to estimate how bad the disk is - Resume support (`--skip-existing`), never overwrites good files silently - Live progress, per-file speed and full log inside the WebGUI
## Support
Please open an issue: https://github.com/kryo0o/unraid-disk-rescue/issues
Requires Unraid 7.3 or newer.
